description: This file defines a Java interface 'ModuleConfigurationDao' which extends a generic DAO interface for 'IntegrationModule' entities. It declares methods for retrieving module configuration details based on module name and code.

classes.name: ModuleConfigurationDao
classes.description: Java interface for accessing module configuration data, extending the generic DAO interface.

methods.name: getModulesConfiguration
methods.description: Retrieves a list of IntegrationModule objects for a given module name.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a specific IntegrationModule based on its module code.
